body.name: Ordered pair contributions
body.construction: For ordered paths \(s_a,s_b\) with \(1\le a<b\le k\), \(t\in\{1,\ldots,T\}\), and \(\ell\in\{0,\ldots,p\}\), set \(E_{ab}=D_{s_a}-D_{s_b}\), \(B_{ab}=T^{-1}E_{ab}^{\top}JE_{ab}\), \(b_{ab,t,\ell}=T^{-1}E_{ab}^{\top}Je_t(E_{ab})_{t,\ell}\), and \(H_{\mathcal S}=\sum_{1\le a<b\le k}B_{ab}\).
